CashFlowEntry.title: CashFlowEntry
CashFlowEntry.description: A single inflow or outflow line item parsed from an MS Excel or CSV cash flow sheet.

periodLabel.description: Period label such as 2026-01 or Jan 2026.

dateMillis.description: Normalized epoch milliseconds for chronological sorting.

category.description: Business category such as Revenue, Payroll, Marketing, or Operations.

amount.description: Non-negative monetary amount in the report's base currency.

note.description: Optional description or memo from the spreadsheet row.

CashFlowReport.title: CashFlowReport
CashFlowReport.description: User-owned MS Excel cash flow report synced to Cloud Firestore.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the report owner.

baseCurrencyCode.description: ISO currency code of the imported amounts (e.g. USD, EUR, INR).

entryCount.description: Count of entries stored in the report.

entries.description: Bounded list of up to 400 cash flow entries.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/cashFlowReports/{reportI.description: Private user-scoped collection storing synced Excel cash flow reports.
